pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. Flank patches exhibit significantly greater spatial area compared to neck patches.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways. Junction nodes typically consist of 3-to-4-way intersections. Pathway pixel thickness is narrow on the neck and wider on the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged 1D silhouette along the upper neck mane, visible against the out-of-focus background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, dark, circular area of textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible on the lower-lateral neck near the shoulder junction, indicative of an acquired lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Small avian organism perched on the dorsal mane of the upper neck.
